headline: One picture, 2 different works
reasons: The same picture was saved as 2 different files and attached to 2 different works in 2 villages. A photo of one site cannot be evidence for 2 separate works.

The 2 files hold one picture saved more than once (for example re-compressed, resized, cut by a few pixels or with another date or GPS stamp printed on it), so their bytes differ. They were matched by comparing the pictures: every two of these files differ in at most 7 of 256 bits of a picture fingerprint (the limit is 8), and their small greyscale copies differ by at most 0.009 (the limit is 0.03).
The files (first 12 characters of each fingerprint): 72bed2489511 on 1 work, aad9974e2508 on 1 work.
The works are recorded as: Other (2).
The picture was uploaded 4 times within 8 minutes (2026-02-12 19:46:25 to 2026-02-12 19:53:31).
